capabilities: Store an immutable version whenever a note's content changes
Browse a per-note version timeline in a sidebar panel
Preview and restore any stored version, including deleted notes
Pin versions and enforce a per-note retention limit
Capture changes made while Obsidian was closed via a startup scan
extras: README warns to back up the vault before use: restoring overwrites current content and resetting the database permanently deletes all versions. History is local only — not synced, not encrypted, and not included in Obsidian Sync. Only .md files are tracked.
problem: Obsidian keeps no per-note timeline of past content, so edits, deletions, and renames can permanently lose earlier text.
summary: Local version-history plugin that stores immutable snapshots of Markdown notes in a vault database and lets you browse, preview, and restore them.
